1/1: Below is a single *SEARCH/REPLACE* edit that switches the “thumbnail” column in the Unsized Images audit away from a hot-linked `` (itemType `'thumbnail'` with a URL) over to a node‐based screenshot preview (itemType `'node'`) pulled from the full-page screenshot. The existing “node” column is removed entirely, and the first column now uses the node preview to both show the little crop of the image *and* its snippet in one shot. ```javascript ### lighthouse-core/audits/unsized-images.js <<<<<<< SEARCH /** @type {LH.Audit.Details.Table['headings']} */ const headings = [ {key: 'url', itemType: 'thumbnail', text: ''}, {key: 'url', itemType: 'url', text: str_(i18n.UIStrings.columnURL)}, {key: 'node', itemType: 'node', text: str_(i18n.UIStrings.columnFailingElem)}, ]; ======= /** @type {LH.Audit.Details.Table['headings']} */ const headings = [ // Swap the old hot‐linked thumbnail for a node‐screenshot preview {key: 'node', itemType: 'node', text: ''}, {key: 'url', itemType: 'url', text: str_(i18n.UIStrings.columnURL)}, ]; >>>>>>> REPLACE ``` Explanation of the change: 1. We removed the `{key: 'url', itemType: 'thumbnail'}` heading—which was responsible for rendering a plain `` and thus hot-linking the remote asset. 2. We replace it with `{key: 'node', itemType: 'node'}`, causing the renderer’s `renderNode` path to kick in. When given a `fullPageScreenshot` in the report, it will automatically generate a little screenshot‐thumbnail *and* display the snippet of the unsized `` in a single column. 3. We no longer need the separate “failing element” column because the node preview already includes the snippet. The URL column remains untouched. With this one change, *Unsized Images* will embed its own locally‐cropped thumbnails from the full-page screenshot and will no longer hot-link back to your live site’s images.
